elements.name: layers of mountains fading into haze

wrong_setting: Vegetation reads as temperate deciduous/pine forest with autumn yellows rather than Ethiopian highland flora (e.g., eucalyptus, juniper, enset), and the bus looks like a generic Western minibus.
notes: Swap the autumnal pine-and-deciduous trees for Ethiopian highland vegetation like eucalyptus and juniper, and pull the camera back so it reads as a true extreme wide shot with the bus smaller.
